population.label: development population (historically exposed; not held-out; freely reusable)

served_list_agreement.served_lists: the frozen retrieval caches (TF32 products); the exhaustive lists here are fp32

loc_cross_check: vectorised LOC order == an independent pure-Python implementation on 290 row-cell pairs (rows < 100 and every 10th)

definitions.ALL: every gold node of the query served
definitions.FRAC: mean over queries of the served fraction of gold nodes
definitions.LOC_SERVES: FLAT@M misses the gold but its LOC-order position < M
definitions.TYPE_A: A(P(g)) = 0: no FLAT top-200 node in the gold's block
definitions.TYPE_B: the block is activated but its first node sits at LOC position >= M (the region ranks too weakly for budget M)
definitions.TYPE_C: the block has >= 1 node inside LOC[:M] but the gold is deeper in the block's FLAT order
definitions.FLAT_budget_matching_this_ALL: the smallest M' with ALL(FLAT@M') >= the arm's ALL at M

workflow: L1 DEVELOPMENT (user ruling 2026-09-26): development -> mechanism selection -> one final held-out evaluation; MetaQA / MuSiQue / SQuAD are development datasets; no p-value here is a verdict
